name: clearconsent
description: Stores the visitor's own consent decision and its metadata so the choice is remembered and not re-prompted every visit.
dataCollected: The granted/denied state per category, a policy version, a timestamp, and a receipt id. No personal identifiers.

name: __cf_bm
description: Cloudflare bot-management and load-balancing cookie that tells humans from automated traffic and keeps a session on the same server.
dataCollected: An opaque token and coarse request signals used to distinguish bots; not used for advertising.

name: AWSALB
description: Keeps a visitor's requests routed to the same backend server (sticky sessions) behind an AWS load balancer.
dataCollected: An encrypted server-affinity token. No personal data.

name: PHPSESSID / JSESSIONID
description: The server session cookie that ties your requests to your logged-in session and cart/form state.
dataCollected: A random session identifier; the data itself stays on the server.

name: csrftoken
description: A security token that protects forms and requests against cross-site request forgery (CSRF).
dataCollected: A random anti-forgery token. No personal data.

name: _ga
description: Google Analytics' main cookie. Assigns each browser a random client id so visits can be counted and grouped into sessions for aggregate reporting.
dataCollected: A randomly generated client id and session counts. Not a name or email, though it is a persistent pseudonymous identifier.

name: _gid / __utma
description: Legacy Universal Analytics cookies used to distinguish users and throttle the request rate.
dataCollected: A pseudonymous user id and timing values. Universal Analytics is deprecated in favor of GA4.

name: _gcl_au
description: Links a click on a Google ad to a later conversion on the site so campaigns can be measured.
dataCollected: An ad-click identifier (GCLID-derived). Used for advertising attribution.

name: IDE
description: DoubleClick cookie used to build an interest profile and show and measure targeted ads across sites.
dataCollected: A persistent advertising identifier and ad-interaction data. Cross-site advertising.

name: _fbp / fr
description: Facebook/Meta advertising cookies. Identify the browser to deliver and measure ads and to build custom audiences.
dataCollected: A browser advertising id and ad-interaction events, shared with Meta. Cross-site advertising.

name: AMCV_
description: Adobe's Experience Cloud ID. A shared visitor identifier used across Adobe Analytics, Target, and Audience Manager.
dataCollected: A persistent Experience Cloud visitor id (MID). Pseudonymous but stable across Adobe products.

name: s_ecid
description: A fallback copy of the Adobe Experience Cloud visitor id, set on the first-party domain.
dataCollected: The Experience Cloud visitor id (MID).

name: s_cc / s_vi
description: Adobe Analytics measurement cookies — check that cookies work, track the previous link clicked, and store the visitor id for reporting.
dataCollected: A visitor id and click/page context for site analytics.

name: mbox
description: Adobe Target cookies that run A/B tests and personalization and remember which experience you were shown.
dataCollected: A Target visitor id and the assigned experiences/segments.

name: demdex
description: Adobe's data-management-platform cookie. Assigns a cross-site id used to build and share audience segments for advertising.
dataCollected: A persistent Demdex id and segment membership, potentially shared with ad partners.

name: kndctr_
description: The Web SDK's first-party identity cookie, storing the Experience Cloud id used by the Edge Network.
dataCollected: The Experience Cloud visitor id and consent state for the Edge.

name: bcookie / li_gc
description: LinkedIn cookies used for ad targeting, conversion tracking, and syncing ids for advertising audiences.
dataCollected: A browser id and ad/sync history, shared with LinkedIn. Cross-site advertising.

name: personalization_id
description: X/Twitter cookies used to personalize and measure advertising and integrate embedded content.
dataCollected: A browser advertising id and ad-interaction data.

name: _ttp
description: TikTok advertising pixel cookies used to measure ad conversions and build audiences.
dataCollected: A browser advertising id and conversion events, shared with TikTok.

name: _hjSessionUser
description: Hotjar behavior-analytics cookies that record a pseudonymous session for heatmaps and session replay.
dataCollected: A random session/user id and interaction sampling flags for UX analytics.

name: _uetsid / MUID
description: Microsoft's Universal Event Tracking cookies used to measure ad conversions and target advertising.
dataCollected: A browser id and conversion events, shared with Microsoft. Cross-site advertising.

name: __hstc / hubspotutk
description: HubSpot CRM/marketing cookies that track a visitor across sessions to attribute forms and personalize content.
dataCollected: A persistent visitor token, session counts, and form-submission linkage.

name: __stripe_mid
description: Stripe cookies used for payment processing and fraud prevention on checkout.
dataCollected: A device id used for fraud detection during payments.

name: intercom-*
description: Intercom live-chat/support cookies that keep a chat session and recognize returning users.
dataCollected: A visitor/session id for the support widget.

name: OptanonConsent
description: OneTrust CMP cookies that store a visitor's consent choices — present if a OneTrust banner is (or was) installed.
dataCollected: The consent state per category and a timestamp.

name: VISITOR_INFO1_LIVE
description: Set by embedded YouTube videos to estimate bandwidth, remember preferences, and measure/serve ads.
dataCollected: A browser id and playback/ad-interaction data, shared with Google.
